Enterprise Features

Designed for regulated industries that demand cutting-edge AIOps without sacrificing customer data confidentiality.

Fail-Closed Privacy Engine

Every telemetry field must be explicitly declared on an allowlist schema. Any unexpected key, unvetted payload, or raw log message is dropped locally before serialization.

Correlation-based Root Cause Analysis

Co-occurring anomalies in CPU, Memory, Disk, and Latency are evaluated by an automated RCA engine that distinguishes hypotheses from verified probable causes.

Edge Isolation Forest

Outlier detection runs on the local collector using temporal feature engineering. Raw observation vectors stay local; only decision scores and severity signals cross the boundary.

Capacity Trend Forecaster

Linear trend velocity calculates exact time-to-exhaustion for storage and memory, warning teams before disk fill or out-of-memory outages occur.
